type: Dictionary<Guid, (string DisplayName, string FullPath, uint DisplayColor, bool ShownInQdb)>

notes.FullPath_empty: Empty string means uncategorized design — no Glamourer folder assigned
notes.DisplayColor: 32-bit RGBA uint — 4294967295 = white/fully opaque. Used by Glamourer for folder coloring
notes.ShownInQdb: Whether the design appears in Glamourer's Quick Design Bar
